title: Updating the Radius Coordinate
statement: For any machine state $st$ and natural number $k$, replacing coordinate $2$ of its 17-entry counter vector by $k$ gives the counter vector of the state obtained from $st$ by setting its radius $s$ to $k$.
replaced:
For any state and any natural number $k$, replacing the third coordinate of its
$17$-component register vector by $k$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by
setting its radius $s$ to $k$.
